answers.core:
It is currently not easy to implement a object that both has collision response and collision testing.
CharacterBody's have test_move but that doesn't tell us when it enters or exits

It is also not possible to have a base class with collision due to the splitting hierarchy of areas and physicalBodies
answers.workaround: Scenes are requires to do such a thing it is not possible as far as I know to implement such a feature purely based on scripts or class_name.
